verdicts.reason: A: the NEW FLAVOR badge has shrunk to an unreadable pill and been dropped below the CTA, away from the product it belongs to. The headline breaks awkwardly, leaving "Light" alone on its own line, and the oversized CTA crowds the copy and sits on the decorative circles. B keeps the original's badge, logo, can and copy order in a sensible left/right banner layout. Its flaws are a headline too small for the canvas, small subtitle text and big uneven vertical gaps in the text column, so the right side looks sparse and weakly organised.
